In rereading ''The Wheel of Time'', I have come across several instances of character sayings which give an indepth look into their outlook on life. For example, it is said in ''New Spring'' that [[Siuan Sanche]] was known for always saying "It was better to ask forgiveness than for permission." Would including things like this would be helpful to this wiki? Or do things like that fall under "copyrighted material" as referred to when editing an entry?

~ Polegnyn 20:56, November 28, 2010 (UTC)

:It wouldn't fall under copyrighted material, as we are allowed to quote the books. It would probably be best to add them to the particular characters' pages. That quote could go on [[Siuan Sanche]]'s page if more recurant quotes of hers can be found. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 05:51, November 30, 2010 (UTC)
